title: Kvartirada 18 kishi boshlagan sayt nimaga aylandi?

scenes.text: 1999 yilda Xitoyning Xanchjou shahrida 18 kishi bitta kvartirada yig'ilib, internet kompaniya tuzdi.
Kvartira egasi sobiq ingliz tili o'qituvchisi edi. O'zi aytishicha, oliygohga kirish imtihonidan ikki marta yiqilgan.
O'sha yillari Xitoyda internetdan foydalanadiganlar hali kam edi.
Bu odam Jek Ma, kompaniya esa Alibaba edi.
2014 yilda Alibaba Nyu-York birjasida aksiyalarini ilk bor sotib, taxminan 25 milliard dollar jalb qildi. O'sha paytdagi rekord edi.

description:
Alibaba 1999 yilda Xanchjouda Jek Ma va yana 17 kishi tomonidan uning kvartirasida tuzilgan. 2014 yil sentyabrida kompaniya Nyu-York birjasida ilk aksiyalarini sotib, taxminan 25 milliard dollar jalb qilgan, bu o'sha paytdagi eng katta IPO edi.

Kichik jamoa katta ish qila oladimi? Izohda fikringizni yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; Wikipedia could not be opened from this session). The Drum 'Meet the 18 original founders of Alibaba', Inc./Associated Press and Business Insider (Ma founded Alibaba in his Hangzhou apartment in 1999 with 17 friends); Wikipedia 'Jack Ma', Britannica and China Daily (former English teacher; failed the university entrance exam twice); phys.org/AFP and Fortune (NYSE IPO September 2014 priced at $68, $21.8 billion base, about $25 billion with the greenshoe, largest IPO ever at the time; later passed by Saudi Aramco 2019). The text already says 'taxminan' and 'o'sha paytdagi'.
